exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KUNDALIK IShLAR - FE'L VA OT BIRIKMASI.

  ⚠ Bu - COLLOCATION mashqi: inglizchada
  qaysi fe'l qaysi ot bilan yuradi.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada bitta fe'l ('qilmoq')
  ko'p narsaga to'g'ri keladi, inglizchada
  esa har ot O'Z fe'lini talab qiladi.


⚠ ENG QIYIN UChTASI - 'DO', 'MAKE',
'HAVE':

  DO - ish, vazifa, uy yumushi
     do homework, do the washing-up,
     do the ironing, do the housework,
     do the shopping

  MAKE - biror narsa YaRATISh
     make a cake, make a mistake,
     make a noise, make friends

  HAVE - ovqat, tajriba, mashg'ulot
     have breakfast, have a shower,
     have a lesson, have a good time

  ⚠ 'do a mistake' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'make homework' - XATO.


⚠ 'GO' + -ING (mashg'ulotlar):

  go shopping, go dancing, go fishing,
  go swimming, go hiking, go skiing

  ⚠ Lekin 'go TO bed' - bu -ING emas,
  chunki 'bed' OT.
  ⚠ 'go to bed' da artikl YO'Q!


⚠ 'LISTEN TO' - PREDLOG ShART:

  'listen TO music' ✓
  'listen music' ✗

  ⚠ Lekin 'watch TV' - predlogsiz.
  ⚠ 'hear' bilan ham predlog yo'q:
  'I hear a noise.'


⚠ 'RIDE' va 'DRIVE':

  ride - ustiga MINIB boshqariladigan
     narsa: a bicycle, a motorbike,
     a horse
  drive - IChIGA kirib boshqariladigan
     narsa: a car, a bus, a lorry


⚠ 'WASH' va 'WASH UP':

  wash - yuvmoq (kir, mashina, yuz)
  do the washing-up - IDISh yuvmoq

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'do the washing-up',
  AQShda 'do the dishes'.
  ⚠ 9-bandda 'the dishes' bilan 'wash'
  ham ishlatilgan - ikkalasi to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Use phrases from Ex. 1a and say two things you: 1 ... do every day. 2 ... do every weekend. 3 ... don't like doing. 4 ... hate doing. 5 ... don't mind doing. 6 ... like doing.
exercises.instructionUz: 1a mashqidagi iboralardan foydalanib, o'zingiz haqingizda ikkitadan narsa ayting: 1 ... har kuni qiladiganingiz. 2 ... har dam olish kunida qiladiganingiz. 3 ... yoqtirmaydiganingiz. 4 ... yomon ko'radiganingiz. 5 ... qarshi bo'lmaganingiz. 6 ... yoqtiradiganingiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOQTIRISh VA YOQTIRMASLIK.

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA: bu fe'llardan
  keyin HAR DOIM -ING shakli keladi.

     like       + -ING
     don't like + -ING
     hate       + -ING
     don't mind + -ING
     enjoy      + -ING
     love       + -ING

  ⚠ 'I hate to do' ham uchraydi, lekin
  -ING tabiiyroq va kitob shuni
  so'rayapti.


⚠ KUChLILIK DARAJASI (kuchsizdan
kuchliga):

  hate          - yomon ko'raman
  don't like    - yoqtirmayman
  don't mind    - qarshi emasman
  like          - yoqtiraman
  love          - juda yaxshi ko'raman

  ⚠ 'don't mind' - o'rtada turadi:
  yoqmaydi ham, yoqadi ham emas -
  ParVO QILMAYMAN.


⚠ 'DON'T MIND' - DIQQAT:

  'I don't mind doing the washing-up.'
  = Idish yuvishga qarshi emasman.

  ⚠ 'Do you mind ...?' esa MULOYIM
  ILTIMOS: 'Do you mind closing the
  window?' = Derazani yopsangiz
  bo'ladimi?
  ⚠ Bunga javob: 'No, not at all.'
  ('No' - ROZILIK bildiradi!)


⚠ 'EVERY DAY' - AJRATIB YOZILADI:

  'I do it every day.' (ravish)
  ⚠ 'everyday' (birga) = SIFAT.

exercises.instructionUz: a) Suratlarga va maqola sarlavhasiga qarang. Somon yo'li nima? b) Qaysi surat nimani ko'rsatadi: orbitadagi kosmik kema; 'kosmik sayr'; sun'iy yo'ldosh; bir-biriga yordam berayotgan kosmonavtlar; kemadagi ekipaj? c) Kosmonavtlar orbitada har kuni nima qiladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNI O'QIShDAN OLDIN TAXMIN QILISh.

  ⚠ Bu 'predicting' - o'qish ko'nikmasining
  muhim qismi: suratlarga va sarlavhaga
  qarab matn nima haqida ekanini
  oldindan bilish.


⚠ 'THE MILKY WAY':

  = SOMON YO'LI - bizning galaktikamiz.

  ⚠ So'zma-so'z: 'sutli yo'l'.
  Qadimgi yunon afsonasiga ko'ra bu -
  osmonga to'kilgan sut.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada 'Somon yo'li' (somon
  sochilgan yo'l).

  ⚠ HAR DOIM 'THE' bilan va KATTA
  harf bilan yoziladi.


SURATLAR:
  A - kosmik kema (space shuttle)
  B - kabinadagi ikki kosmonavt
  C - sun'iy yo'ldosh (satellite)
  D - ochiq kosmosdagi kosmonavt
  E - (13-betda) kemaning manipulyator
      qo'li yonidagi kosmonavt


⚠ KOSMIK SO'ZLAR:

  a space shuttle - qayta ishlatiladigan
     kosmik kema
  orbit - orbita ('IN orbit' - artiklsiz!)
  a space walk - ochiq kosmosga chiqish
  a satellite - sun'iy yo'ldosh
  a spaceship - kosmik kema
  a crew - ekipaj
  aboard - bort ustida
  Mission Control - uchish boshqaruv
     markazi

  ⚠ 'IN ORBIT' - artiklsiz turg'un ibora.
  ⚠ 'ABOARD a spaceship' - 'on board'
  ning qisqa shakli.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR 13-BETDAGI MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu maqola o'qiladi, shuning
  uchun mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish
  mumkin - matndan tekshiring.

  ⚠ 1-band kitobda ALLAQAChON
  belgilangan (namuna): 6:41.


⚠ 'CST' NIMA:

  = Central Standard Time
  = Markaziy standart vaqt (AQShning
    markaziy mintaqasi - Chikago).

  ⚠ Matnda: 'that's the same time that
  people in Chicago use'.

  ⚠ Kosmosda 'ertalab' va 'kechqurun'
  yo'q - shuning uchun ekipaj YERDAGI
  bir vaqt mintaqasiga qarab yashaydi.


⚠ SOATNI O'QISh:

  6:41 pm = 'six forty-one pm'
  ⚠ Yoki: 'nineteen minutes to seven'.

  ⚠ 'pm' = tushdan keyin (post meridiem)
  ⚠ 'am' = tushgacha (ante meridiem)


⚠ 'TWO SIX-HOUR' - DEFISGA DIQQAT:

  'two six-hour space walks'
  = ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr

  ⚠ 'six-hour' - defis bilan va HOUR
  BIRLIKDA ('six-hours' XATO), chunki
  u SIFAT vazifasida.

  ⚠ 'six two-hour' bo'lsa: oltita ikki
  soatlik sayr - butunlay boshqa ma'no!

tasks.prompt: 1  Mission Control wakes the crew up with music at exactly ___ pm CST.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda ALLAQAChON belgilangan - namuna.

⚠ Matnda: 'Mission Control wakes the crew up
with music at exactly 6:41pm CST'.

⚠ Matnda: "Washing isn't EASY in space."

⚠ DIQQAT: gapda INKOR bor. "isn't difficult"
teskari ma'no berardi.

tasks.prompt: 3  Each day there are also ___ space walks.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'Each day there are also TWO SIX-HOUR
space walks.'

⚠ IKKITA olti soatlik - oltita ikki soatlik emas!

tasks.prompt: 4  Sometimes we sit by the window and admire the ___ and the stars.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'we sit by the window and admire the
EARTH and the stars'.

⚠ 'the Earth' - sayyora nomi sifatida KATTA harf
va 'the' bilan.

exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Bu yana COLLOCATION mashqi.


⚠ 'A COUPLE OF HOURS':

  = bir-ikki soat.
  ⚠ 'a couple' aslida 'ikki' degani,
  lekin 'a couple of' aniq son emas -
  'bir nechta' ma'nosida.

  ⚠ 'of' ni TUShIRIB QOLDIRMANG:
  'a couple hours' - AQSh so'zlashuv
  nutqida uchraydi, lekin yozuvda XATO.


⚠ 'TO HELP EACH OTHER':

  = bir-biriga yordam bermoq.
  ⚠ 'each other' - IKKI kishi uchun.
  ⚠ 'one another' - ko'p kishi uchun
  (lekin farq deyarli yo'qolgan).


⚠ 'A ROCK SONG':

  ⚠ 'rock' bu yerda MUSIQA turi.
  Boshqa ma'nolari: tosh, qoya;
  tebranmoq.


⚠ 'PERSONAL' va 'PERSONNEL':

  personal (PER-sonal) = shaxsiy
  personnel (person-NEL) = xodimlar

  ⚠ Imlosi va urg'usi boshqa - juda
  ko'p adashtiriladi.


⚠ 'A WET SPONGE':

  ⚠ 'wet' = ho'l; aksi 'dry' = quruq.
  ⚠ 'a sponge' - 'spanj' deb o'qiladi;
  'g' YuMShOQ (j kabi).

exercises.explanationUz:
YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.

  ⚠ Har juftlikdagi ikki so'z o'zbekchaga
  BIR XIL tarjima qilinadi - shuning
  uchun ular ataylab qarshi qo'yilgan.


⚠ 'A PIECE' va 'A PART':

  a piece of music = musiqa ASARI
     (butun bir kuy)
  a part of sth = biror narsaning
     QISMI

  ⚠ 'music' sanalmaydigan, shuning
  uchun 'a PIECE of music'.


⚠ 'WORK' va 'A TASK':

  work = umuman ish (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  a task = aniq bitta vazifa
     (SANALADIGAN)

  ⚠ 'a difficult work' - XATO,
  chunki 'work' sanalmaydigan.
  To'g'risi: 'difficult work' yoki
  'a difficult task'.


⚠ 'A PROJECT' va 'A WORK':

  a project = reja asosidagi katta ish
  ⚠ 'works' (ko'plikda) = asarlar
  (adabiy, musiqiy) yoki zavod.


⚠ 'ADMIRE' va 'LOOK':

  to admire = zavq bilan qaramoq
  to look AT = shunchaki qaramoq

  ⚠ 4-bandda 'looking' variantida
  predlog 'AT' yo'q - shuning uchun
  ham grammatik jihatdan XATO
  bo'lardi.


⚠ 'TAKE UP' va 'TAKE OVER':

  take up = boshlamoq (mashg'ulot),
     joy egallamoq
  take over = navbatni/ishni qabul
     qilmoq

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the shuttle's computers
  TAKE OVER for the night'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: crew, audience, fans, viewers.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: crew, audience, fans, viewers.
exercises.explanationUz:
ODAMLAR GURUHINING NOMLARI.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada hammasi 'tomoshabinlar'
  yoki 'guruh' bo'lishi mumkin, lekin
  inglizchada HAR BIRI O'Z joyida
  ishlatiladi.


FARQLARI:

  a crew = kema/samolyot/kosmik kema
     XODIMLARI (ekipaj)

  an audience = teatr, konsert,
     ma'ruzadagi TINGLOVChILAR
     (bir joyda o'tirgan)

  fans = MUXLISLAR (sportchi, xonanda,
     jamoaning)

  viewers = TELEKO'RUVChILAR
     (uyda televizor ko'radiganlar)

  ⚠ 'a viewer' - 'to view' (ko'rmoq)
  fe'lidan.
  ⚠ 'a fan' - 'fanatic' so'zining qisqa
  shakli.


⚠ QAYSI FE'L QAYSI GURUH BILAN:

  crew    - welcomes passengers
  fans    - shout, cheer
  audience - claps, applauds
  viewers - watch

  ⚠ 2-bandda 'shouting' (baqirish) -
  bu STADIONDA bo'ladi, demak 'fans'.
  ⚠ 3-bandda 'clapped' (qarsak) va
  'the play' (spektakl) - demak
  'audience'.


⚠ JAMOA OTLARI - FE'L BIRLIKDAMI
YOKI KO'PLIKDA:

  Britaniyada IKKALASI ham mumkin:
     'The crew IS ready.' (bir butun)
     'The crew ARE ready.' (alohida
        odamlar)

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the crew WASH themselves'
  va 'The crew TAKE a short break' -
  KO'PLIKDA.

  ⚠ 'fans' va 'viewers' esa oddiy
  ko'plik otlar - har doim ko'plikda.

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLI IBORALAR - HAMMASI
MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Predlogni MANTIQ bilan topib
  bo'lmaydi - ular ibora bilan BIRGA
  yodlanadi.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  IN orbit = orbitada
     ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ turg'un ibora.

  ON a mission = topshiriqda
     ⚠ 'on a trip', 'on a journey' kabi.

  wake sb UP = uyg'otmoq
     ⚠ 'up' - predlog emas, ZARRAChA.
     To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi
     mumkin: 'wake me up'.

  work ON projects = loyiha ustida
     ishlamoq

  go back TO work = ishga qaytmoq
     ⚠ 'work' artiklsiz.

  sit BY the window = deraza yonida
     o'tirmoq
     ⚠ 'by' = yonida, yaqinida.
     ⚠ 'at the window' ham mumkin.

  according TO NASA = NASA ma'lumotiga
     ko'ra
     ⚠ 'according to ME' - XATO!
     O'z fikringiz uchun 'in my opinion'
     deyiladi.

  take over FOR the night = tun uchun
     navbatni olmoq


⚠ 'WAKE UP' - IKKI XIL:

  o'timsiz: 'I wake up at seven.'
     (o'zim uyg'onaman)
  o'timli: 'She wakes me up.'
     (meni uyg'otadi)

'wakes the crew up'.

YETIShMAYOTGAN GAPNI TOPISh.

⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI - UCh QADAM:

  1) Bo'shliqdan OLDINGI gapni o'qing
  2) Bo'shliqdan KEYINGI gapni o'qing
  3) Ikkalasiga MANTIQAN bog'lanadigan
     gapni tanlang

  ⚠ BOG'LOVChI SO'ZLAR eng katta
  yordamchi:
     'For example' - oldin umumiy fikr

TAHLIL:

     Oldin: 'The pieces of music are

     Javob (b): 'For example, they might
        wake up to a traditional Japanese
        song one day, and a new American
        rock song the next!'
     ⚠ 'For example' - oldingi umumiy
     fikrga MISOL.

  2-bo'shliq:
     Oldin: 'The crew take a short break
        for lunch...'
     Keyin: 'According to NASA, the crew's
        special meals are tasty...'
     Javob (c): 'They need a lot of energy,
        so they eat a lot of food.'
     ⚠ Mavzu - OVQAT.

  3-bo'shliq:
     Oldin: "it's not all work and no play
        aboard the space shuttle"
     Keyin: 'Most of us read and send our
        personal e-mail in this free time...'
     Javob (a): "In the 'evening' we all

        dinner and relax."
     ⚠ Keyingi gapda 'THIS free time'
     deyilgan - demak oldin BO'Sh VAQT
     tilga olingan bo'lishi kerak.


⚠ 'ALL WORK AND NO PLAY':

  To'liq maqol: 'All work and no play
  makes Jack a dull boy.'
  = Faqat ishlab, dam olmagan odam
    zerikarli bo'lib qoladi.

exercises.instructionUz: SOMON YO'LI ATROFIDA KECHA VA KUNDUZ
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan (bo'shliqlar to'ldirilgan
holda).


⚠ MATNNING TUZILIShI:

  Kirish - Leroy Chiao kim va nima
     haqida gapiradi
  'Good Morning!' - uyg'onish, yuvinish,
     nonushta
  "Let's get busy!" - ish, kosmik sayr,
     tushlik
  'Astronauts need to rest, too!' -
     bo'sh vaqt va uyqu

  ⚠ Uchta kichik sarlavha - kunning
  uchta qismi. 13-betdagi Speaking
  mashqi aynan shu bo'linishni so'raydi.


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'MORNING', 'AFTERNOON',
'EVENING' TIRNOQ IChIDA:

  Orbitada kema Yer atrofida 90 daqiqada
  aylanadi - ya'ni bir kunda 16 marta
  quyosh chiqadi va botadi!

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'ertalab' va 'kechqurun'
  ShARTLI: ekipaj Yerdagi soatga
  (CST) qarab yashaydi.

  ⚠ Tirnoq belgisi 'bu haqiqiy ertalab
  emas' degan ma'noni beradi.


⚠ VAQTLAR:

  6:41 pm CST - uyg'onish
  8:45 pm CST - ish boshlanishi
  8:45 am CST - ishning tugashi
  10:41 am CST - uyqu

  ⚠ Ya'ni ekipajning 'kuni' kechqurun
  boshlanadi va ertalab tugaydi -
  Yerdagi vaqt bo'yicha teskari.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  a wet sponge  = ho'l gubka
  a task        = vazifa, topshiriq
  a razor       = ustara
  to involve    = o'z ichiga olmoq
  an activity   = mashg'ulot
  a view        = manzara
  closely       = yaqindan, zich
  a break       = tanaffus
  personal      = shaxsiy
  to admire     = zavqlanib qaramoq
  to take over  = navbatni olmoq

tasks.en: NIGHT AND DAY AROUND THE MILKY WAY
tasks.uz: SOMON YO'LI ATROFIDA KECHA VA KUNDUZ

tasks.en: "Every day aboard a space shuttle is different in many ways, but you're always busy up there!" said crew member Leroy Chiao.
tasks.uz: "Kosmik kemadagi har kun ko'p jihatdan boshqacha, lekin u yerda doim bandsan!" - dedi ekipaj a'zosi Leroy Chiao.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'aboard' = bort ustida ('on board' ning
qisqa shakli).
⚠ 'in many ways' = ko'p jihatdan.
⚠ 'up there' = u yerda, yuqorida (kosmosda).

tasks.en: ... when we asked him to tell us about a typical day on a mission in orbit.
tasks.uz: ... biz undan orbitadagi topshiriqda odatiy kun haqida gapirib berishni so'raganimizda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to ask sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'ON a mission' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 'IN orbit' - artiklsiz.

tasks.en: Every 'morning', Mission Control wakes the crew up with music at exactly 6:41pm CST (Central Standard Time - that's the same time that people in Chicago use).
tasks.uz: Har 'ertalab' Boshqaruv markazi ekipajni aynan CST bo'yicha 18:41 da musiqa bilan uyg'otadi (Markaziy standart vaqt - Chikago aholisi ishlatadigan vaqt).
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to wake sb UP' - 'up' zarrachasi bilan.
To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
'wakes the crew up'.
⚠ 'exactly' = aynan, roppa-rosa.

tasks.en: The pieces of music are always different. For example, they might wake up to a traditional Japanese song one day, and a new American rock song the next!
tasks.uz: Musiqa asarlari har doim boshqacha. Masalan, bir kuni an'anaviy yapon qo'shig'i bilan, ertasiga yangi amerika rok qo'shig'i bilan uyg'onishlari mumkin!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a piece of music' = musiqa asari.
'music' SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'a piece of' kerak.
⚠ 'might' = ehtimol (5-mashqning javobi).

tasks.en: After that, they have a couple of hours to wash, have breakfast and get the 'morning' messages from Mission Control.
tasks.uz: Shundan keyin ularda yuvinish, nonushta qilish va Boshqaruv markazidan 'ertalabki' xabarlarni olish uchun bir-ikki soat bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a couple of' = bir-ikki (aniq ikki emas).
⚠ 'to have time TO DO sth' - infinitiv.

tasks.en: Washing isn't easy in space, and it's impossible to have a shower, so the crew wash themselves with a wet sponge.
tasks.uz: Kosmosda yuvinish oson emas va dush qabul qilish imkonsiz, shuning uchun ekipaj o'zini ho'l gubka bilan yuvadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Kosmosda og'irlik yo'q - suv oqmaydi, balki
sharcha bo'lib uchadi.
⚠ 'themselves' - O'ZLIK olmoshi.
⚠ 'a sponge' - 'spanj' deb o'qiladi.

tasks.en: Shaving is also a difficult task up there, so the men have to use special 'space' razors.
tasks.uz: U yerda soqol olish ham qiyin vazifa, shuning uchun erkaklar maxsus 'kosmik' ustaralardan foydalanishga majbur.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'shaving' - -ING shakli EGA vazifasida.
⚠ 'a task' = vazifa (7-mashqda ham bor).
⚠ 'have to' = majbur bo'lmoq (10-unit mavzusi).

tasks.en: At around 8:45 pm CST, the crew starts work. Most of the time they work on projects involving satellites and the shuttle itself.
tasks.uz: CST bo'yicha taxminan 20:45 da ekipaj ishni boshlaydi. Ko'p vaqt ular sun'iy yo'ldoshlar va kemaning o'ziga oid loyihalar ustida ishlaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to work ON a project' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 'involving' = o'z ichiga olgan.
⚠ 'the shuttle ITSELF' = kemaning O'ZI
(ta'kidlash uchun).

tasks.en: They also take photos of their activities and the view from the shuttle to send home.
tasks.uz: Ular yana mashg'ulotlarining va kemadan ko'rinadigan manzaraning suratini olib, uyga yuboradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to TAKE photos' - 'to make' EMAS.
⚠ 'a view OF sth' - predlog 'of'.

tasks.en: Each day there are also two six-hour space walks.
tasks.uz: Har kuni yana ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'six-hour' - DEFIS bilan, HOUR BIRLIKDA
(sifat vazifasida).
⚠ 'each day' = har kuni ('every day' bilan
bir xil).

tasks.en: "We have between eight and ten minutes to do each task," says Leroy, "so we have to work very closely and help each other."
tasks.uz: "Har vazifani bajarish uchun sakkiz-o'n daqiqamiz bor," - deydi Leroy, "shuning uchun juda zich ishlashimiz va bir-birimizga yordam berishimiz kerak."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'between ... and ...' = ... dan ... gacha.
⚠ 'closely' - RAVISh ('close' + -ly).
⚠ 'each other' = bir-biri (12-betdagi
3b mashqida ham bor).

tasks.en: The crew take a short break for lunch during the 'afternoon'.
tasks.uz: Ekipaj 'tushdan keyin' tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to TAKE a break' - 'to do' EMAS.
⚠ 'the crew TAKE' - Britaniyada jamoa oti bilan
fe'l KO'PLIKDA bo'lishi mumkin.

tasks.en: They need a lot of energy, so they eat a lot of food. According to NASA, the crew's special meals are "tasty and very good for them".
tasks.uz: Ularga ko'p quvvat kerak, shuning uchun ko'p ovqat yeydi. NASA ma'lumotiga ko'ra, ekipajning maxsus taomlari "mazali va ular uchun juda foydali".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to' (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'good FOR sb' = foydali.
⚠ 'energy' va 'food' - SANALMAYDIGAN otlar,
shuning uchun 'a lot of'.

tasks.en: After lunch, they go back to work until around 8:45 am CST.
tasks.uz: Tushlikdan keyin ular CST bo'yicha taxminan 08:45 gacha ishga qaytadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'go back TO work' - predlog 'to' (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'work' bu yerda artiklsiz.

tasks.en: "Fortunately, it's not all work and no play aboard the space shuttle," says Leroy.
tasks.uz: "Yaxshiyamki, kosmik kemada faqat ish emas," - deydi Leroy.
tasks.note:
⚠ To'liq maqol: 'All work and no play makes
Jack a dull boy.' = Faqat ishlab dam olmagan
odam zerikarli bo'lib qoladi.

⚠ 'fortunately' = yaxshiyamki ('fortune' -
omad).

tasks.en: "In the 'evening' we all have a couple of hours to have dinner and relax. Most of us read and send our personal e-mail in this free time, but we also like to read books or listen to music."
tasks.uz: "'Kechqurun' hammamizda kechki ovqat qilish va dam olish uchun bir-ikki soat bo'ladi. Ko'pchiligimiz shu bo'sh vaqtda shaxsiy elektron xatlarimizni o'qiymiz va yuboramiz, lekin kitob o'qish yoki musiqa tinglashni ham yoqtiramiz."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'most of us' - 'of' bilan (olmoshdan oldin).
⚠ 'personal' = shaxsiy (6-mashqda ham bor).

tasks.en: "Sometimes we sit by the window and admire the Earth and the stars."
tasks.uz: "Ba'zan deraza yonida o'tirib Yer va yulduzlarga zavq bilan qaraymiz."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to sit BY the window' - predlog 'by'
(= yonida).
⚠ 'to admire' = zavqlanib qaramoq
(7-mashqda ham bor).

tasks.en: After that, at exactly 10:41 am CST, it's time for the crew to go to bed, while Mission Control and the shuttle's computers take over for the 'night'.
tasks.uz: Shundan keyin, CST bo'yicha aynan 10:41 da ekipajning uxlash vaqti keladi, Boshqaruv markazi va kemaning kompyuterlari esa 'tun' uchun navbatni oladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "it's time for sb TO DO sth" - turg'un qolip.
⚠ 'to go TO bed' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'to take over' = navbatni olmoq, ish boshini
qabul qilmoq (7 va 9-mashqlarda ham bor).

exercises.instructionEn: We use the present simple to talk about daily routines and habits. e.g. He goes to work by bus.
exercises.instructionUz: Present simple ni kundalik tartib va odatlar haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz. Masalan: U ishga avtobusda boradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  'We use the present simple to talk
   about daily routines and habits.'
  e.g. He goes to work by bus.

  ⚠ 'e.g.' = 'exempli gratia' (lotincha)
  = masalan.


⚠ 'BY BUS' - TRANSPORT USULI:

  by bus, by car, by train, by plane,
  by bike, by taxi

  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ! 'by a bus' - XATO.
  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' = piyoda
  ('by foot' XATO).


3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S QOIDALARI
(10-mashqning butun mavzusi):

  1) Ko'pchilik fe'lga oddiy -S:
     play → plays, read → reads,
     make → makes, leave → leaves

  2) -O, -S, -SH, -CH, -X bilan
     tugasa → -ES:
     go → goes, do → does,
     watch → watches, finish → finishes,
     brush → brushes, fix → fixes

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IES:
     study → studies, fly → flies

  4) UNLI + Y → faqat -S:
     play → plays, buy → buys

  5) ISTISNO: have → HAS


⚠ -S NING TALAFFUZI - UCh XIL:

  /s/  - jarangsiz tovushdan keyin:
     makes, sleeps, works
  /z/  - jarangli tovushdan keyin:
     plays, reads, goes
  /iz/ - shivirlovchi tovushdan keyin:
     watches, finishes, brushes

  ⚠ Bu qoida ko'plik -S ga ham,
  o'tgan zamon -ED ga ham o'xshash.

exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarni uchinchi shaxs birlikda yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK (he/she/it).

  ⚠ Bu - ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p
  unutiladigan qoida. O'zbekchada
  fe'l shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi,
  shuning uchun -S doim esdan chiqadi.


QOIDALAR VA BANDLAR:

  ODDIY -S:
     play → plays (3)
     read → reads (4)
     make → makes (7)
     leave → leaves (8)

  -O, -S, -SH, -CH, -X → -ES:
     go → goes (1)
     watch → watches (2)
     finish → finishes (6)
     do → does (9)
     brush → brushes (10)

  ISTISNO:
     have → has (5)


⚠ 'DOES' TALAFFUZI:

  'do' /duː/ → 'does' /dʌz/
  ⚠ Unli TOVUSh o'zgaradi!

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday 'say' /seɪ/ →
  'says' /sez/.


⚠ INKOR VA SO'ROQDA -S TUShADI:

  He goes. → He doesn't GO.
  He goes? → Does he GO?

  ⚠ 'He doesn't goes' - XATO.
  ⚠ -S allaqachon 'does' ichida.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ -O bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ Talaffuzi /gəʊz/.

⚠ -CH bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ Talaffuzi /ˈwɒtʃɪz/ - qo'shimcha BO'G'IN
qo'shiladi.

⚠ UNLI + Y, shuning uchun faqat -S.
⚠ 'plaies' - XATO.

⚠ Oddiy -S.
⚠ Talaffuzi /riːdz/ - jarangli /z/.

⚠ ISTISNO! 'haves' - XATO.
⚠ Faqat 'have' shunday o'zgaradi.

⚠ -SH bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ Qo'shimcha BO'G'IN: /ˈfɪnɪʃɪz/.

⚠ Oddiy -S.
⚠ Talaffuzi /meɪks/ - jarangsiz /s/.

⚠ Oddiy -S.
⚠ 'a leaf' (barg) → 'leaves' bilan ADAShTIRMANG -

⚠ -O bilan tugagani uchun -ES.

exercises.instructionEn: List the adverbs of frequency, then say where we usually place such adverbs in a sentence.
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlarini tartib bilan yozing, so'ng gapda ular odatda qayerga qo'yilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI - 0% dan
100% gacha.

  1  never        0%
  2  rarely       ~10%
  3  occasionally ~25%
  4  sometimes    ~40%
  5  often        ~60%
  6  usually      ~85%
  7  always       100%

  ⚠ Kitobda 1 (never) va 7 (always)
  BERILGAN - qolgan beshtasini
  ro'yxatdan joylashtirasiz.


⚠ GAPDA QAYERGA QO'YILADI - UCh QOIDA:

  1) ODDIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
     'I ALWAYS get up early.'
     'He OFTEN plays football.'

  2) 'TO BE' DAN KEYIN:
     'She is ALWAYS late.'
     'They are USUALLY at home.'
     ⚠ 'She always is late' - XATO!

  3) YORDAMChI FE'L BILAN - o'rtada:
     'I have NEVER been to London.'
     'He can USUALLY come.'

  ⚠ Qisqa qoida: ravish ASOSIY fe'ldan
  oldin, lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN.


⚠ ISTISNO - GAP BOShIDA VA OXIRIDA:

  'sometimes', 'usually', 'often',
  'occasionally' gap boshida ham
  turishi mumkin:
     'Sometimes I go to the cinema.'

  ⚠ Lekin 'always' va 'never' gap
  boshida TURMAYDI (buyruq gapdan
  tashqari: 'Never do that!').


⚠ 'RARELY', 'SELDOM', 'HARDLY EVER':

  Uchalasi ham 'kamdan-kam' degani.
  ⚠ Ular INKOR ma'noli, shuning uchun
  gapda yana 'not' QO'ShILMAYDI:
  'I rarely don't go' - XATO.


⚠ 'HOW OFTEN ...?' - SAVOL:

  'How often do you play tennis?'
     - 'Twice a week.'
     - 'I usually play at weekends.'

exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLIB GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Uchta sarlavha - maqoladagi uchta
  kichik sarlavhaga aynan mos keladi:
     'Good Morning!' → the 'morning'

  shuncha ERKIN bo'lasiz - yodlab
  o'qib bermaysiz.

  PRESENT SIMPLE:

  'The crew wakeS up at 6:41 pm.'
  'They have a couple of hours to wash.'

tasks.en: the 'morning': 6:41 pm CST - wake up with music; a couple of hours to wash (wet sponge, special razors), have breakfast, get messages from Mission Control
tasks.uz: 'ertalab': CST 18:41 - musiqa bilan uyg'onish; yuvinish (ho'l gubka, maxsus ustara), nonushta, Boshqaruv markazidan xabarlar olish uchun bir-ikki soat

tasks.uz: 'kechqurun': kechki ovqat va dam olish uchun bir-ikki soat; shaxsiy elektron xat o'qish va yuborish, kitob o'qish, musiqa tinglash, deraza yonida o'tirib Yerga zavq bilan qarash; CST 10:41 - uxlash

tasks.en: A typical day: First, the crew wake up at 6:41 pm CST. Then they wash and have breakfast. After that, they start work at 8:45 pm. Finally, they go to bed at 10:41 am.
tasks.uz: Odatiy kun: Avval ekipaj CST bo'yicha 18:41 da uyg'onadi. Keyin yuvinadi va nonushta qiladi. Shundan keyin 20:45 da ishni boshlaydi. Nihoyat, 10:41 da uxlagani yotadi.

After that, Finally.

qiladi - bu 4-unitning mavzusi ham.

exercises.explanationUz:
UCh XIL 'HOW' SAVOLI.

  HOW FAR ...?   - MASOFA
     'How far is your office?'
     - 'It's 40 kilometres.'

  HOW ...?       - USUL (qanday)
     'How do you get there?'
     - 'I go by bus.'

  HOW LONG ...?  - VAQT
     'How long does it take?'
     - 'It takes nearly an hour.'

  ⚠ Javobga qarab savolni topish oson:
     kilometr → how far
     avtobus  → how
     soat     → how long


⚠ 'IT TAKES' - VAQT UChUN:

  'It takes an hour to get there.'
  = U yerga borish bir soat oladi.

  ⚠ Ega HAR DOIM 'it'.
  ⚠ Qolip: It takes + (kim) + VAQT +
     to + FE'L
     'It takes me twenty minutes to walk
      to school.'


⚠ 'GET THERE' - PREDLOGSIZ:

  'How do you get THERE?'
  ⚠ 'get to there' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'there', 'here', 'home' oldidan
  'to' QO'YILMAYDI.

  ⚠ Lekin joy nomi bilan 'to' kerak:
  'How do you get TO school?'


⚠ 'NEARLY AN HOUR':

  ⚠ 'an hour' - 'h' O'QILMAYDI, shuning
  uchun 'AN' artikli ('a hour' XATO).
  ⚠ 'nearly' = deyarli.


⚠ "I DON'T MIND":

  = qarshi emasman, parvo qilmayman.
  ⚠ 12-betdagi 2-mashqda ham bor edi.

qurish uchun):

  • the supermarket; 15 kilometres;

  • the seaside; 40 kilometres; by train;
    30 minutes; quick, so I often go at
    weekends
  • the park; 2 kilometres; on foot;
    20 minutes; a pleasant walk, so I go
    every day

  ⚠ 'ON FOOT' - 'by foot' XATO!

wordFormation.explanationUz: Fe'l + zarracha butunlay yangi ma'no beradi. 9-mashqdagi iboralar.
Betdagi bir necha so'z uzun so'zning qisqartmasi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have breakfast and do my homework every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har kuni nonushta qilaman va uy vazifamni bajaraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - odat.
⚠ 'every day' AJRATIB yoziladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I like / don't like / hate / don't mind [-ING].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't mind doing the washing-up, but I hate doing the ironing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Idish yuvishga qarshi emasman, lekin dazmol qilishni yomon ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu fe'llardan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.
⚠ Kuchlilik: hate < don't like < don't mind <
like < love.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Which picture shows a satellite? - Picture C.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qaysi surat sun'iy yo'ldoshni ko'rsatadi? - C surati.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Each day there are two six-hour space walks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Har kuni ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'six-hour' - DEFIS bilan va HOUR BIRLIKDA,
chunki u sifat vazifasida.
⚠ 'six-hours' - XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: First, the crew wake up. Then they have breakfast. After that, they start work. Finally, they go to bed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avval ekipaj uyg'onadi. Keyin nonushta qiladi. Shundan keyin ishni boshlaydi. Nihoyat, uxlagani yotadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ KETMA-KETLIK so'zlari - kundalik tartibni
so'zlashning asosi.
⚠ Har biridan keyin VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: They have a couple of hours to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have a couple of hours to wash and have breakfast.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda yuvinish va nonushta qilish uchun bir-ikki soat bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a couple OF' - 'of' ShART.
⚠ 'time TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: According to NASA, the meals are tasty.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to'.
⚠ 'according to me' - XATO! 'In my opinion'
deyiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's time for the crew to go to bed.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Turg'un qolip: 'it's time for sb to do sth'.
⚠ 'go TO bed' - artiklsiz.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John wakes up at 5:00 am and has a shower.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon soat 5:00 da uyg'onadi va dush qabul qiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I always make my bed in the morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har doim ertalab to'shagimni yig'aman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Takrorlanish ravishi ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN.
⚠ Lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN: 'She is always late.'

sentencePatterns.formula: What time does he have [fan]? - He has [fan] from ... till ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time does Tom have Maths? - He has Maths from 9:10 till 10:00.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom matematikani soat nechada o'qiydi? - 9:10 dan 10:00 gacha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Fan nomi KATTA harf bilan va ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - ikkalasi ham ShART.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How far is your office? - It's 40 kilometres.

sentencePatterns.formula: How long does it take? - It takes [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long does it take to get there? - It takes nearly an hour.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yerga borish qancha vaqt oladi? - Deyarli bir soat.

sentencePatterns.formula: I go by [transport]. / I go on foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I usually go by bus. / I go to the park on foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odatda avtobusda boraman. / Bog'ga piyoda boraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'BY' + transport, ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON foot' ('by foot' XATO).
